name: VizWiz-VQA: Visual Question Answering from Blind Photographers
description: VizWiz-VQA is a visual question answering benchmark originating from real-world photos taken by blind individuals asking questions about their daily surroundings. Developed by the VizWiz Consortium, it comprises 31,173 visual questions in its initial CVPR 2018 release (subsequently expanded to 32,842 across train, validation, and test splits), each paired with 10 crowd-sourced answers, featuring challenging artifacts such as motion blur, framing issues, unanswerable questions, and privacy concerns.
